subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core replayable session process-event API now, and what taxonomy, replay, authorization, redaction, and UI/source-of-truth contract should it use?
rationale: The request is useful but crosses stable gateway protocol, session state, UI, SDK/plugin, and security boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the core contract first
options.body: Approve a short design for process/step taxonomy, persistence/replay, observer authorization, redaction, and mapping from current streams before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to existing streams
options.body: Improve or document agent item/session.tool/task/audit streams without adding a new process-event family yet.

options.title: Defer to client-specific integration
options.body: Ask ClawWork or another client to consume current generic streams for now, accepting that stable cross-client process semantics remain unsolved.

recommendation.title: Design the core contract first
recommendation.body: Approve a short design for process/step taxonomy, persistence/replay, observer authorization, redaction, and mapping from current streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places steipete closest to gateway event, audit, task, and session protocol design surfaces.
